The PR title becomes the commit message on main and drives the version number.
Use Conventional Commits:  <type>(<optional scope>): <lowercase summary>

  feat: ...      new feature            -> minor release (0.X.0)
  fix: ...       bug fix                -> patch release (0.0.X)
  perf/refactor/deps: ...               -> patch release
  feat!: ... or "BREAKING CHANGE:" in the body -> major release
  docs/test/ci/chore/style: ...         -> no release
-->
